messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: high 95p latency and elevated 502 errors in eu-west economy tier. source: smart-routing metrics. traffic spike -> econ-lane. dashboard: https://redwood.internal/d/alerts/2155555555 :rotating_light:

maria (oncall): paging. i'm on it. grabbing latest graphs and logs. who has access to smart-routing policy console?

alex (sre): oncall here. i can take routing changes. starting traces on the affected hosts. prelim: kv-cache thrash + enqueue depth high on econ-gpu-3.

jamie (infra): noticed a correlated burst from a handful of IPs in eu-west. looks like a reseller client sending large batched requests.

maria (oncall): severity S2 for now, customer-facing errors reported. need containment: rate limit econ-tier in eu-west + steer economy traffic to fallback region or standard tier. want minimal customer disruption.

diana (product): any payments tied to that reseller? acmeX is on growth plan, not dedicated. they may see degraded responses but we should avoid full disable if possible.

alex (sre): i'm going to apply a temporary dampening policy: reduce econ-lane weight in eu-west from 1.0 -> 0.25 and enable regional-steer -> eu-central. running dry-run then apply.

alex (sre): ```
# dry-run
./rtctl policy simulate --name regional-eu-econ-dampener --from eu-west --to eu-central --weight 0.25
# apply
./rtctl policy apply --name regional-eu-econ-dampener --env prod --from eu-west --to eu-central --weight 0.25 --reason "mitigate econ spike"
```

deploy-bot: POLICY APPLY STARTED: regional-eu-econ-dampener by alex. change id: pol-9213. CI checks passed.

ops-bot: PAGED: routing-change requested. notify oncall and infra.

maria (oncall): alex please also add a short-lived quota for the noisy client and log the client id. we'll relax if needed.

jamie (infra): creating client quota now. command: ```
redwood-cli quota set --client acmeX --region eu-west --limit 1000/min --ttl 30m --reason "incident mitigation"
```

deploy-bot: POLICY APPLY COMPLETE: pol-9213 -> active. rolling changes to routing-proxies eu-west-*.

alex (sre): seeing p95 drop from 2.2s -> 650ms within 45s. 502s down ~80%. economy lane QPS reduced. good signal.

maria (oncall): client acmeX throttled to 1000/min. track support channel for any messages. tagging @support-lead.

carlos (eng): quick thought — the eviction spikes line up with recent LRU change in runtime 2.8.0. if this repeats, consider rolling runtime to 2.7 for econ nodes. not for now, just note.

alex (sre): agree. set monitoring alert for cache-miss rate and eviction count.

triage-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-215555 assigned to maria. priority S2. runbook: smart-routing dampening -> quota -> monitor.

maria (oncall): i'm handing off to jamie for the stabilization window. jamie — you own until 2155555590, will check back for final signoff.

jamie (infra): taking over. i'll keep an eye. if error rate creeps back, plan B: temporarily disable economy-tier for new sessions in eu-west and return traffic to standard-tier only. that requires a config flip: ```
./rtctl policy apply --name disable-econ-eu-west --action drop-new-weights --weight-econ 0
```

diana (product): please avoid long-term disable. prioritize targeted client quotas + steer. contact list: @sales-acmeX, support to draft proactive note.

jamie (infra): updating incident timeline and actions in the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026

alex (sre): rolling logs show noisy client now under quota and compliant. p95 stable at 600-700ms. keeping dampener in place for 30m.

maria (oncall): thanks team. leaving notes: mitigation = smart-routing dampener + per-client quota. no dedicated customer outages reported. recommend follow-up: root cause RCA (cache eviction + bursty client patterns) and consider per-client burst protections.

triage-bot: HANDOFF: maria -> jamie at 2155555580.

jamie (infra): will watch until 2155555590, then update incident to monitoring-only if stable. logging final metrics and closing play if steady for 15m.

maria (oncall): acknowledged. if anything spikes, reopen thread or escalate to S1. thanks. :thumbsup:

-- end of thread --
